title: [BE] Remove pyobj_interpreter_ from PyObjectSlot (v2)
body:
PyObjectSlot stored a pointer to the PyInterpreter alongside the PyObject, but this was always the global interpreter when set. Remove the field and have callers use getGlobalPyInterpreter() directly.

This also removes HermeticPyObjectTLS.

A previous attempt at this was reverted, but we're now in 2026 so maybe we'll be luckier. The previous revert may have been caused by a bug where stray writes to TensorImpl made it sensitive to changes in size, which was fixed in #167564.

Authored with Claude.
